mapper.select: SELECT inst_id, bar, ts, open, high, low, close, vol, vol_ccy, vol_ccy_quote, confirm FROM okx_candle_cache WHERE inst_id = #{instId} AND bar = #{bar} AND ts >= #{fromTs} AND ts <= #{toTs} ORDER BY ts ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO okx_candle_cache ( inst_id, bar, ts, open, high, low, close, vol, vol_ccy, vol_ccy_quote, confirm ) VALUES ( #{instId}, #{bar}, #{ts}, #{open}, #{high}, #{low}, #{close}, #{vol}, #{volCcy}, #{volCcyQuote}, #{confirm} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open = VALUES(open), high = VALUES(high), low = VALUES(low), close = VALUES(close), vol = VALUES(vol), vol_ccy = VALUES(vol_ccy), vol_ccy_quote = VALUES(vol_ccy_quote), confirm = VALUES(confirm)

INSERT INTO okx_candle_cache ( inst_id, bar, ts, open, high, low, close, vol, vol_ccy, vol_ccy_quote, confirm ) VALUES
( #{row.instId}, #{row.bar}, #{row.ts}, #{row.open}, #{row.high}, #{row.low}, #{row.close}, #{row.vol}, #{row.volCcy}, #{row.volCcyQuote}, #{row.confirm} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open = VALUES(open), high = VALUES(high), low = VALUES(low), close = VALUES(close), vol = VALUES(vol), vol_ccy = VALUES(vol_ccy), vol_ccy_quote = VALUES(vol_ccy_quote), confirm = VALUES(confirm)
